name: @neuropause/platform-automation
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Management System — Version 1.1 Program 1B: Production Infrastructure Automation. An additive package that composes Waves 1-14, Sprints 1-6, Launch Workstreams 1-5, and Version 1.1 Program 1A, unchanged, into a governed infrastructure-automation layer that converts every step of the Production Infrastructure Operations Manual into an executable, evidence-first automation generator: an automation engine with a registry, execution planner, dependency resolver, dry-run engine, execution history, and rollback planner supporting a strictly side-effect-free Preview mode and an approval-gated Execute mode; Terraform module generators (AWS/Azure/GCP/self-hosted Kubernetes; production/staging/development — plans only, never applied); Kubernetes automation (namespace/network-policy/resource-quota/storage-class/RBAC/ingress/HPA/pod-security/configmap/secret-reference manifests reusing the existing Helm deployment); database provisioning descriptors (PostgreSQL/Redis/Qdrant with backup schedules, restore procedures, monitoring, health checks, encryption — never provisioned automatically); DNS & TLS automation (records, load balancer, ingress, cert-manager, renewal, verification — represented until executed); secrets automation (HashiCorp Vault/AWS Secrets Manager/Azure Key Vault/Google Secret Manager/External Secrets Operator with rotation, revocation, audit, validation — secret values never exposed); monitoring automation (Prometheus/Grafana/Loki/OpenTelemetry/Alertmanager descriptors + infrastructure/Kubernetes/database/AI/API dashboards); backup automation (scheduled backups, snapshot verification, restore validation, DR drills — reusing the platform-operations backup-recovery engine); CI/CD automation (GitHub Actions for build/test/security-scan/SBOM/container-signing/deployment-validation/rollback-validation — reusing the Release packaging and trust-platform SBOM; never deploys to production without explicit approval); production validation automation (Kubernetes/APIs/databases/identity/monitoring/logging/TLS/storage → machine-readable reports); evidence automation (deployment logs, rollout status, image digests, certificate fingerprints, backup verification, health reports → evidence packages; never auto-promoted); an operations dashboard (automation/pending/executed/failed/verification/rollback status — no simulated production metrics); and governance. The automation engine, execution planner, dependency resolver, dry-run engine, rollback planner, every generator, the validation runtime, the evidence generator, the operations dashboard, and governance are LIVE-VERIFIED in-process; Terraform providers, Vault, cloud secret managers, GitHub Actions, and cert-manager are ADAPTER-VERIFIED; production automation runs, deployment metrics, and operational KPIs are BUSINESS-DATA-PENDING; and cloud accounts, Kubernetes clusters, DNS zones, TLS certificates, and production networks are INFRASTRUCTURE-PENDING. Preview never modifies infrastructure; Execute requires explicit operator approval and NEVER creates cloud resources, deploys clusters, configures production secrets, publishes DNS, issues certificates, promotes evidence, or claims successful deployment. Every automation execution is recorded on the one governance chain with a replay id.
